steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: A client approved your estimate. Here's how to turn it into an invoice and send it.

steps.caption: Search for the client
steps.narration: On Clients, search for the client.

steps.caption: Open the client
steps.narration: Click the name to open their page.

steps.caption: The approved estimate
steps.narration: Under Estimates, the approved estimate has a Create invoice button.

steps.caption: A draft invoice
steps.narration: The invoice appears under Invoices as a draft, with the same title and total.

steps.caption: Preview
steps.narration: Choose Preview to see it the way your client will.

steps.caption: The client's view
steps.narration: This is the client's view, after they confirm their email.

steps.caption: Amount due and due date
steps.narration: Your company details are at the top, with the amount due and the due date.

steps.caption: Send
steps.narration: Then choose Send. The client gets an email with a link to the invoice.

steps.caption: Sent; Record payment
steps.narration: The invoice is now marked sent. Record payment is here for when the money comes in.

steps.caption: Invoiced
steps.narration: And the estimate shows it's been invoiced, with the invoice number.

steps.caption: Menu: Invoices
steps.narration: Every invoice you send is listed under Invoices in the menu.

youtube.title: How to create and send an invoice | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of invoicing in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will turn an approved estimate into a draft invoice, preview what the client sees, send it, and see the invoice marked sent with Record payment ready for when the money comes in.
